dataset_source: Worldline and the Machine Learning Group, Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB)
licence: Database: Open Database Licence 1.0 (ODbL); contents: Database Contents Licence 1.0 (DbCL)
preparation: A 50,000-row stratified sample (seed 42) of the deduplicated Worldline/ULB benchmark: 49,917 legitimate and 83 fraudulent transactions. The original has 284,807 rows and 492 frauds; removing 1,081 exact duplicate records precedes sampling. This is a public anonymized transaction benchmark, not synthetic data. The download URL is documented in TensorFlow's official [imbalanced-classification tutorial](https://www.tensorflow.org/tutorials/structured_data/imbalanced_data).
